title: I made a dark narrative game with Claude: a night guard, one window, 11 endings (Act I out, free)
author: Fit_Cell_3561
selftext:
I work as a security guard in Poland, and that's where the idea for this game came from. I made Checkpoint with Claude (Claude Code + Godot 4). Act I is finally out, so I wanted to share it here.



\*\*The setup\*\*

March 2011. You work the night shift in a security booth. You have a barred window, a phone, a list of numbers and a monitor with five cameras. That's the whole world of the game. You never leave the booth.



\*\*How it plays\*\*

Someone knocks. You raise the shutter and listen. Then you choose: LET IN, ASK or REFUSE. Some visitors are on the list. Some only say they are. Some aren't who they claim to be, and the only way to find out is to ask the right questions, check the cameras or pick up the phone.



In the morning your manager goes through every mistake you made. Your pay barely covers food and child support, so every decision at the window is also a decision about whether you'll have enough this month.



Then a man in a mask shows up at the window and tells you that from today you work for them.



\*\*What's in Act I\*\*

\- 8 nights, about an hour per run

\- 11 endings, some of them dead ends: getting fired, hunger, debt, the police

\- English and Polish

\- Free on [itch.io](http://itch.io) (Windows)



The full game is designed so that finishing it opens a second, new playthrough: ACT II.

You return to the same nights, knowing what you know now.

New conversations, new paths and different endings open up.

Act II is in the works. Whether I finish it depends on whether people want it, so any feedback helps a lot.



[https://checkpointgame.itch.io/checkpoint](https://checkpointgame.itch.io/checkpoint)
